Messages.Author: legb...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
This was in my pigeon hole when i got back to work. I suspect Steve Cantlow or
Lunar Moon, but i spose it could be Garry. A small reward is offered for
information leading to the apprehension of the poet. A LARGE reward is offered
to the poet, cos i think this is HILARIOUS!!!!

ODE TO LEGBITER
Legbiter, legchewer, the nipper of toes
Is already dead, but just doesn't know
He disrupts my business and kills my friends
But little does he know, that i'll get him in the end.

I'll stop all his plans, and ruin his fun
And stick all his ideas right up his bum.
And if he trys to sneak and use lots of stealth
Then my minions will see that he loses his health.

And if he trys to attack and stick the boot in
Then i've got some ideas to see he don't win
I'll smash and i'll bash and i'll thump and i'll crunch
And all that i'll leave is a short bloody stump.

So give in and give up, just do as your told
And i might leave intact your pitiable soul.

[signed] The Grande Maitre De to Mr M Hatter

Messages.Author: carl.pi...@at.ccmail.philips.com
Messages.Body:
A critical situation is arising here in Vienna.

Our local shop (the one which really supports VTES) is running out of
VTES Boosters. They are unable to get replenishments; in the past, they
always managed to have VTES on stock. Sabbat might last a few months yet.

Has anyone experienced similar problems?
Can someone tell me where the local shop could get large quantities of
cards at *reasonable* prices?

It seems that VTES is slowly running out. Question is: what will happen when
there are no cards of the basic set available? Will WotC reprint the basic
set, or create a 2nd Edition (which would be a good thing to correct some
minor flaws of the game)?

Hey, fellow players, how is it going in your area?

Carl
(VEKN Prince of Vienna)

Messages.Author: Robert F. Grau
Messages.Body:
This isn't going to aid Legbiter's cause, but as long as the title is
"poetry corner"
I'll take full advantage.

I now pause so all may scuffle of to retrieve a cup of specially blended
java for the occasion.

Thank you, and now, Jyhad in haiku.

"Potence"

Immortal Grapple
defeats a strike: combat ends
when range is set close

"Gangrel"

Here Kitty, Kitty.
Aid from Bats; Army of Rats
Claws will be your end.

"Ventrue"

The Brujah have no
concept of society.
Come Kiss My Ra, fool!

"Malkavian"

? Citizens Lucid
Not are we cause mad being
is this seeming odd

"Naivaklam"

Odd seeming this is.
Being mad, 'cause we are not.
Lucid Citizens ?

Thanks again, I'll be here all week.

Messages.Author: deanfl...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
How about some verses appropriate for the Madness of the Bard?

Awake, thou fool, and block this deed
Else I thy scantling pool will bleed.

Now answer all my summons here
Ye rats and rodents fair and fell
And take my foeman unawares
With aye your army out from hell.

This here is my gift benevolent
To make this minion mine potent.

Celeritas the Latins height
What Saxons call as quick as light. ( height being the past of
an archaic form of "call")

Then from my generous plenitude
I give this vampire fortitude.

What man can bear vicissitude,
Its fortunes swift and upsets rude?

Who breaks within these blasphemous dark halls,
Disturbs our sleepless slumber and our wreck
Of all unfinished dreams, and slays our thralls
Till we must needs awake and intercept.



Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <19990424005552...@ng42.aol.com>, Halcyan 2
<halc...@aol.com> writes

>Because if I remember correctly from English class,
>there are a whole bunch of different kinds of rhyming schemes (and some are
>pretty deranged!).

Well, you can work with internal rhymes (rhyming with words in the
middle of the sentence) and eye rhymes (words that look like they should
rhyme). Half rhymes (words which kind of rhyme) would also be possible.

--
James Coupe (Accepted (pending grades) for English by Cambridge University)
